about: Real numbers behind part two of the Learn page, written by analysis/pipeline/learn_data.py (never by hand). matches rows: date, home club, away club (indexes into clubs), home goals, away goals, ensemble home and draw, market home and draw, all probabilities in tenths of a percent; the away win is the rest. The ensemble is the published one, graded out of sample; the market is the closing average with the margin removed.
